order: escape, code, strong, em, link\n    text = html_escape(text)\n    # code\n    text = re.sub(r'`([^`]+)`', r'<code>\\1</code>', text)\n    # strong\n    text = re.sub(r'\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*', r'<strong>\\1</strong>', text)\n    # code fence\n        if line == \"```\":\n            start = i\n            i += 1\n            while i < n and lines[i] != \"```\":\n                i += 1\n            if i < n:\n                i += 1\n            code_lines = lines[start+1:i-1] if i < n else lines[start+1:i]\n            escaped = [html_escape(l) for l in code_lines]\n            code_content = \"\\n\".join(escaped)\n            blocks.append(f\"<pre><code>{code_content}</code></pre>\")\n            continue\n        #
